data_structures.name: pipeline/state.json
data_structures.purpose: Tracks the multi-agent pipeline lifecycle state

schema.state: enum(idle, planning, executing, reviewing, testing, reporting, done)

data_structures.name: thread-registry
data_structures.purpose: Registry of active Codex threads for parallel development

data_structures.name: scan.db
data_structures.purpose: SQLite database storing structured scan results for query and verification

data_structures.name: extract-data.json
data_structures.purpose: Local extraction output from AST/regex analysis — intermediate format before load into scan.db

schema.scan_meta: object (scan_date, scan_mode, scan_scope, scan_topic, extraction_method, ai_tokens_used)
schema.modules: array of {name, path, responsibility, exported_symbols, dependencies, file_count, loc}
schema.functions: array of {name, module_id, signature, file_path, line_number, is_public}

data_flows.name: User Request Lifecycle
data_flows.description: Primary request flow from user input through Claude Code gate to execution and commit
steps: User request received
CLAUDE.md gate check: read requirements, assess complexity (5 criteria)
Search .claude/memory/ for historical lessons
User confirms requirements
Route to appropriate workflow (debug/review/parallel/complex/simple)
Delegate to Codex (code tasks) or CC (trivial/non-code)
Two-round review (CC + Codex depth for diff>100 lines)
Validation gate: functionality, tests, types, no API break
Git commit with conventional commit message

data_flows.name: Scan Pipeline
data_flows.description: Structured scan lifecycle: extract code structure, load into DB, query, verify, export
steps: cmd_scan: initialize scan with mode (M1-M4), scope, topic
cmd_extract: local AST/regex extraction of modules, functions, imports
cmd_load: import extract-data.json into scan.db (SQLite)
cmd_query: structured + fuzzy queries against scan.db
cmd_verify: artifact completeness check (required fields present)
cmd_export_to_claude_md: generate CLAUDE.md scan summary section

data_flows.name: Git Hook Chain
data_flows.description: Sequential hook execution for every tool use that touches the filesystem
steps: PreToolUse: git_safety_check.py — analyze workspace risk (HIGH>=60, MEDIUM>=25)
Tool execution proceeds if safety check passes
PostToolUse: append_changelog_draft.py — record changed files for changelog
Stop: auto_checkpoint_commit.py — auto-commit if unstaged changes exceed threshold
PreToolUse (merge): pre_merge_scope_guard.py — verify merge scope against task table
PreToolUse (parallel): verify_parallel_scope.py — verify parallel dev scope isolation

data_flows.name: Parallel Development
data_flows.description: Multi-agent parallel development workflow with scope isolation
steps: Plan task and identify independent subtasks
Decouple: define owned file paths per subtask
Create worktrees for each parallel track
Launch independent Codex sessions per worktree
verify_parallel_scope.py: enforce no cross-boundary modifications
pre_merge_scope_guard.py: verify merge diff against declared scope
Merge results after all tracks complete

api_surface.name: analyze_workspace
api_surface.description: Analyzes workspace state: branch, changed files, unstaged age, worktree detection. Returns workspace analysis dict for checkpoint decision.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Return dict keys are consumed by main(); new keys are safe, removing keys breaks callers

api_surface.name: risk_level
api_surface.description: Computes risk level from workspace state. Returns 'HIGH' (score>=60), 'MEDIUM' (score>=25), or 'LOW'. Blocks dangerous git operations at HIGH risk.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Threshold values are constants; changing return enum values breaks all callers

api_surface.name: build_message
api_surface.description: Builds human-readable risk assessment message for Claude Code hook output.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Output format consumed by CC hook parser; maintain JSON structure

api_surface.name: verify_scope
api_surface.description: Verifies that changed files fall within allowed scope patterns. Returns {ok, violations, warnings}.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Return dict structure is contract; new fields safe, removing fields breaks callers

api_surface.name: build_scope_policy
api_surface.description: Parses scope table rows and builds policy dict with allowed_patterns, allowed_exact, forbidden_shared.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Policy dict keys consumed by verify_scope(); maintain key names

api_surface.name: parse_scope_table
api_surface.description: Parses Markdown scope table into structured row dicts with task, owner, paths, shared columns.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Table column names are implicit contract; document any column changes

api_surface.name: run_scope_verify
api_surface.signature: run_scope_verify(project_dir, table_path, task_name, base_ref, target_ref) -> dict
api_surface.description: Runs full scope verification: loads table, resolves task, computes diff, checks violations. Returns {approved, violations}.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Return dict consumed by main() for allow/block decision

api_surface.name: extract_merge_source_branch
api_surface.description: Parses git merge command text to extract source branch name. Returns None if not a merge command.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Return type None on failure is contract; caller checks for None

api_surface.name: infer_task_name_from_branch
api_surface.description: Infers task name from branch naming convention (e.g. 'feat/task-name' -> 'task-name').
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Branch naming convention is implicit; document any pattern changes

api_surface.name: cmd_extract
api_surface.description: Performs local AST/regex extraction of code structure. Outputs extract-data.json with modules, functions, imports.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Output JSON schema is consumed by cmd_load; maintain schema contract

api_surface.name: cmd_verify
api_surface.description: Verifies scan artifact completeness: checks all required fields in scan-data.json and scan.db tables.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Verification criteria must match scan-data.json schema

api_surface.name: cmd_query
api_surface.description: Structured + fuzzy query against scan.db. Supports querying modules, functions, constraints, impact items.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Query interface is stable; new query types are additive

api_surface.name: validate_scan_data
api_surface.description: Schema validation for scan-data.json. Returns list of error strings (empty = valid).
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Validation rules must match scan-data.json schema; errors are strings

api_surface.name: create_zip_backup
api_surface.description: Creates ZIP backup of changed files before checkpoint commit. Returns backup file path.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Return value is backup path string; caller logs it

api_surface.name: do_commit
api_surface.description: Stages all changes and creates git commit with given message. Returns True on success.
api_surface.compatibility_strategy: Boolean return is contract; caller checks for commit success

reference_constraints.constraint: Codex 4 mandatory params: model, sandbox, approval-policy, reasoning
reference_constraints.impact: All Codex MCP calls must include all 4 parameters with exact values (model=gpt-5.4, sandbox=danger-full-access, approval-policy=on-failure)
Forces task decomposition; any change exceeding 200 lines must be split into independent commits

reference_constraints.constraint: File operation boundary: no rm -rf, no git reset --hard, no force push to main/master
reference_constraints.impact: Safety protection against destructive operations; block-delete.py hook enforces this
Scan and parallel scope operations must exclude these directories to prevent noise and accidental modification

reference_constraints.constraint: scan-data.json must pass schema validation before load into scan.db
reference_constraints.impact: Ensures data integrity; invalid scan data is rejected with error messages listing missing/invalid fields

reference_constraints.constraint: No new third-party dependencies beyond Pillow/tkinter for image-merger
reference_constraints.impact: Keeps sample application dependency-free; any new import must be from Python stdlib

impact_matrix.direct_impact: All workflows reference constants for Codex params, diff limits, file boundaries, and gate checks
impact_matrix.indirect_impact: Every user request flow passes through constants; affects CC/Codex role boundary, approval policies, scope exclusions

impact_matrix.validation_point: Run full scan pipeline: extract -> load -> query -> verify -> export

impact_matrix.validation_point: Test HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW risk scenarios with various workspace states

impact_matrix.direct_impact: All git merge operations are scope-checked before execution
impact_matrix.indirect_impact: Branch naming convention changes affect task name inference; table path resolution affects parallel workflow
impact_matrix.validation_point: Test merge scenarios: in-scope merge, out-of-scope merge, missing task table

impact_matrix.direct_impact: Parallel development scope verification — enforces file ownership boundaries
impact_matrix.indirect_impact: Scope table parsing changes affect all parallel workflows; pattern matching changes affect what files are allowed/denied
impact_matrix.validation_point: Test parallel scope scenarios: exact match, pattern match, shared file violation, forbidden shared file

impact_matrix.direct_impact: Code generation quality rules loaded by Claude Code for all code tasks

impact_matrix.validation_point: Generate code with Codex and verify rules are applied in output
